<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem Visual Proof</title>
  
  <defs>
    <!-- Background grid -->
    <pattern id="grid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>

    <!-- Drop shadow -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-opacity="0.15"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Arrow marker -->
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#475569"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="url(#grid)"/>

  <!-- Title & Subtitle -->
  <text x="400" y="40" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Pythagoras' Theorem: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$</text>
  <text x="400" y="65" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">The area of the squares on the two shorter sides equals the area of the square on the hypotenuse.</text>

  <!-- ==================== MAIN GRAPHIC ==================== -->
  
  <!-- Coordinates setup: Triangle vertices at A(250, 320), B(130, 320), C(250, 200) -> wait, let's adjust for nice numbers:
       Let a = 120px (base, side b)
       Let b = 90px (height, side a)
       Let c = 150px (hypotenuse, side c)
       Scale: 1 unit = 1 pixel for square areas or just relative. Let's make triangle legs 120 and 90.
       Vertex 1 (Right angle): (220, 320)
       Vertex 2 (Left): (220 - 120 = 100, 320) -> length b = 120
       Vertex 3 (Top): (220, 320 - 90 = 230) -> length a = 90
       Hypotenuse runs from (100, 320) to (220, 230). Length c = 150.
       Let's shift everything right and down for better centering:
       Right angle at (240, 330)
       Left vertex: (120, 330) -> distance 120
       Top vertex: (240, 240) -> distance 90
       Hypotenuse: from (120, 330) to (240, 240) -> distance 150.
  -->

  <!-- GROUP FOR LEFT/BOTTOM/TOP SQUARES & TRIANGLE -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 20)" filter="url(#shadow)">
    
    <!-- Square on side b (bottom, width 120, height 120, downwards from y=330) -->
    <rect x="120" y="330" width="120" height="120" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#fb923c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="180" y="395" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c" text-anchor="middle">b²</text>
    <text x="180" y="415" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#9a3412" text-anchor="middle">120² = 14400</text>

    <!-- Square on side a (left, width 90, height 90, leftwards from x=120) -->
    <rect x="30" y="240" width="90" height="90" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="75" y="290" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>
    <text x="75" y="310" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#1e40af" text-anchor="middle">90² = 8100</text>

    <!-- Square on hypotenuse c (built outwards to the top-left) -->
    <!-- Vector from (120,330) to (240,240) is (120, -90). Perpendicular pointing outwards (top-left) is (-90, -120).
         Corner 1: (120, 330)
         Corner 2: (240, 240)
         Corner 3: (240 - 90, 240 - 120) = (150, 120)
         Corner 4: (120 - 90, 330 - 120) = (30, 210)
    -->
    <polygon points="120,330 240,240 150,120 30,210" fill="#bbf7d0" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="135" y="225" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">c²</text>
    <text x="135" y="245" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">150² = 22500</text>

    <!-- The Central Right-Angled Triangle -->
    <polygon points="120,330 240,330 240,240" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <!-- Right angle symbol -->
    <polyline points="225,330 225,315 240,315" fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Triangle Side Labels -->
    <text x="180" y="355" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">b = 12 cm</text>
    <text x="260" y="285" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="start">a = 9 cm</text>
    <text x="165" y="270" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-36.87 165 270)">c = 15 cm</text>

  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LABELS & ANNOTATIONS ==================== -->
  
  <!-- Label pointers / Highlights -->
  <g font-family="system-ui, sans-serif">
    <!-- Hypotenuse label -->
    <line x1="210" y1="230" x2="270" y2="180" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <rect x="270" y="165" width="130" height="30" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="335" y="185" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">Hypotenuse (c)</text>
    <text x="335" y="200" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Longest side, opposite right angle</text>

    <!-- Right angle label -->
    <line x1="280" y1="350" x2="330" y2="390" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <rect x="330" y="380" width="110" height="26" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="385" y="398" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">Right Angle (90°)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== ANIMATED CONCEPT PANEL ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 100)" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="280" height="350" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    
    <text x="140" y="35" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Area Breakdown</text>
    
    <!-- Formula breakdown items -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 60)">
      <!-- a squared block -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="30" height="30" rx="4" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="15" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>
      <text x="45" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#334155">=</text>
      <text x="65" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8">9²</text>
      <text x="120" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">=</text>
      <text x="145" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">81 cm²</text>
    </g>

    <g transform="translate(20, 110)">
      <!-- b squared block -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="30" height="30" rx="4" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#fb923c" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="15" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c" text-anchor="middle">b²</text>
      <text x="45" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#334155">=</text>
      <text x="65" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c">12²</text>
      <text x="120" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">=</text>
      <text x="145" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">144 cm²</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Divider line -->
    <line x1="20" y1="160" x2="260" y2="160" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Sum block -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 180)">
      <text x="15" y="20" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">a² + b²</text>
      <text x="85" y="20" font-size="16" fill="#334155">=</text>
      <text x="110" y="20" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">81 + 144</text>
      <text x="25" y="50" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">=</text>
      <text x="50" y="50" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">225 cm²</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Final c squared result -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 260)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="60" rx="6" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="120" y="25" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">Therefore, c² = 225</text>
      <text x="120" y="47" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">c = √225 = 15 cm</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== ANIMATION ==================== -->
  <!-- We pulse/highlight the hypotenuse square and the text to draw attention -->
  <style>
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.02); stroke-width: 4px; }
      100% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
    }
    .anim-square {
      transform-origin: 135px 210px;
      animation: pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  </style>
  
  <!-- Applying animation group over hypotenuse square -->
  <g class="anim-square">
    <polygon points="120,330 240,240 150,120 30,210" fill="none" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="3" pointer-events="none"/>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .title { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subtitle { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; fill: #1e293b; }
    .label-desc { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; fill: #64748b; }
    
    .circle-bg { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 4; }
    .diameter-line { stroke: #ef4444; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .radius-line { stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .circ-line { fill: none; stroke: #10b981; stroke-width: 6; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .centre-dot { fill: #1e293b; }
    
    .panel { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 2; rx: 10; }
    
    /* Animations */
    @dash {
      to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    
    .anim-circ {
      stroke-dasharray: 942; /* approx circumference 2 * pi * 150 = 942 */
      stroke-dashoffset: 942;
      animation: drawCirc 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }
    
    @keyframes drawCirc {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 942; }
      70% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg" />

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="400" y="38" class="title">Key Parts of a Circle</text>
  <text x="400" y="60" class="subtitle">GCSE Mathematics Revision</text>

  <!-- LEFT SIDE: The Visual Circle Diagram -->
  <g transform="translate(230, 260)">
    <!-- Main Circle Area -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" class="circle-bg" />
    
    <!-- Circumference Animated Highlight -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" class="circ-line anim-circ" />

    <!-- Diameter Line (Full width) -->
    <line x1="-150" y1="0" x2="150" y2="0" class="diameter-line" />

    <!-- Radius Line (Right half) -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="150" y2="0" class="radius-line">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.4;1;0.4" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </line>

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" class="centre-dot" />
    
    <!-- Pulsing Centre Ring -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="6;20" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- RIGHT SIDE: Information Panels -->
  
  <!-- Panel 1: Centre -->
  <g transform="translate(430, 90)">
    <rect width="345" height="75" class="panel" />
    <circle cx="25" cy="37" r="8" fill="#1e293b" />
    <text x="50" y="30" class="label">Centre</text>
    <text x="50" y="52" class="label-desc">The exact middle point of the circle.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Panel 2: Radius -->
  <g transform="translate(430, 175)">
    <rect width="345" height="75" class="panel" />
    <line x1="12" y1="37" x2="38" y2="37" class="radius-line" />
    <text x="50" y="30" class="label">Radius</text>
    <text x="50" y="52" class="label-desc">Distance from the centre to any point</text>
    <text x="50" y="68" class="label-desc">on the edge. (Half of diameter)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Panel 3: Diameter -->
  <g transform="translate(430, 260)">
    <rect width="345" height="75" class="panel" />
    <line x1="10" y1="37" x2="40" y2="37" class="diameter-line" />
    <text x="50" y="30" class="label">Diameter</text>
    <text x="50" y="52" class="label-desc">Distance across the circle, passing</text>
    <text x="50" y="68" class="label-desc">through the centre. ($d = 2r$)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Panel 4: Circumference -->
  <g transform="translate(430, 345)">
    <rect width="345" height="75" class="panel" />
    <circle cx="25" cy="37" r="12" class="circ-line" />
    <text x="50" y="30" class="label">Circumference</text>
    <text x="50" y="52" class="label-desc">The total distance all the way</text>
    <text x="50" y="68" class="label-desc">around the outside ($C = \pi d$).</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Interactive / Educational Hint Footer -->
  <rect x="35" y="440" width="730" height="40" fill="#e0f2fe" rx="6" stroke="#bae6fd" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="400" y="465" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="600" font-size="14" fill="#0369a1" text-anchor="middle">
    💡 Watch the green outer boundary animate to show the Circumference!
  </text>

  <!-- Direct labels pointing to the main circle diagram (Left side) -->
  <text x="235" y="245" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="#1e293b">Centre</text>
  
  <text x="310" y="245" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="#3b82f6">Radius ($r$)</text>
  
  <text x="130" y="245" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="#ef4444">Diameter ($d$)</text>

  <text x="320" y="125" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="12" fill="#10b981">Circumference</text>
  <path d="M 315 130 Q 280 150 250 120" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series Circuit Concept Diagram</title>

  <style>
    .bg { fill: #fcfcfc; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 2; }
    .wire { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #1e293b; font-weight: bold; }
    .sublabel { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #64748b; }
    .title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; fill: #0f172a; font-weight: bold; text-anchor: middle; }
    .box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8; }
    .highlight-box { fill: #f0fdf4; stroke: #22c55e; stroke-width: 2; rx: 6; }
    .volt-box { fill: #eff6ff; stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 1.5; rx: 6; }
    
    /* Electron flow animation */
    .electron { fill: #f59e0b; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background Card -->
  <rect x="20" y="20" width="760" height="460" class="bg" rx="12" />

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="55" class="title">Series Circuit: One Loop & Shared Voltage</text>

  <!-- Circuit Loop Wires -->
  <!-- Top Wire -->
  <path d="M 230 140 L 570 140" class="wire" />
  <!-- Bottom Wire -->
  <path d="M 230 380 L 570 380" class="wire" />
  <!-- Left Wire with Cell -->
  <path d="M 150 200 L 150 140 L 230 140" class="wire" />
  <path d="M 150 320 L 150 380 L 230 380" class="wire" />
  <!-- Right Wire -->
  <path d="M 650 140 L 650 380" class="wire" />
  <!-- Connectors -->
  <path d="M 570 140 L 650 140" class="wire" />
  <path d="M 570 380 L 650 380" class="wire" />

  <!-- Cell (Battery) on Left -->
  <g transform="translate(150, 260)">
    <rect x="-25" y="-60" width="50" height="120" class="box" />
    <line x1="-15" y1="-30" x2="15" y2="-30" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="6" />
    <line x1="-8" y1="-15" x2="8" y2="-15" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="-15" y1="20" x2="15" y2="20" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="6" />
    <line x1="-8" y1="35" x2="8" y2="35" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="25" y="-25" class="label" fill="#ef4444">+</text>
    <text x="25" y="30" class="label">-</text>
  </g>
  <text x="150" y="405" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Cell (Voltage V)</text>

  <!-- Component 1 (Resistor/Lamp 1) - Top -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 140)">
    <rect x="-45" y="-25" width="90" height="50" class="volt-box" />
    <!-- Resistor zig-zag -->
    <path d="M -30 0 L -22 -12 L -14 12 L -6 -12 L 2 12 L 10 -12 L 18 12 L 26 -12 L 30 0" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3" />
  </g>
  <text x="400" y="95" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Component 1</text>
  <text x="400" y="115" class="sublabel" text-anchor="middle">Voltage V₁</text>

  <!-- Component 2 (Resistor/Lamp 2) - Right -->
  <g transform="translate(650, 260)">
    <rect x="-25" y="-45" width="50" height="90" class="volt-box" />
    <!-- Resistor zig-zag vertical -->
    <path d="M 0 -30 L 12 -22 L -12 -14 L 12 -6 L -12 2 L 12 10 L -12 18 L 12 26 L 0 30" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3" />
  </g>
  <!-- Fixed label X position to stay well inside viewBox (max X = 800) -->
  <text x="690" y="245" class="label">Component 2</text>
  <text x="690" y="265" class="sublabel">Voltage V₂</text>

  <!-- Switch - Bottom -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 380)">
    <rect x="-35" y="-20" width="70" height="40" class="box" />
    <circle cx="-15" cy="0" r="4" fill="#334155" />
    <circle cx="15" cy="0" r="4" fill="#334155" />
    <line x1="-15" y1="0" x2="12" y2="-12" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </g>
  <text x="400" y="425" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Closed Switch</text>

  <!-- Concept Explanations Callout Boxes -->
  <!-- Top Loop / Current Callout -->
  <rect x="210" y="170" width="160" height="60" class="highlight-box" />
  <text x="290" y="193" class="label" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#166534">Same Current</text>
  <text x="290" y="213" class="sublabel" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12">Flows everywhere in loop</text>

  <!-- Voltage Sharing Callout -->
  <rect x="440" y="250" width="180" height="65" class="volt-box" />
  <text x="530" y="274" class="label" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#1d4ed8">Shared Voltage</text>
  <text x="530" y="296" class="sublabel" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12">V<sub>cell</sub> = V₁ + V₂</text>

  <!-- Animated Current Flow Path -->
  <path id="circuitPath" d="M 150 240 
           L 150 140 
           L 650 140 
           L 650 380 
           L 150 380 
           L 150 280" fill="none" stroke="none" />

  <!-- Electrons moving along the circuit -->
  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>
  
  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="2s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <circle r="6" class="electron">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" begin="3s" repeatCount="indefinite">
      <mpath href="#circuitPath" />
    </animateMotion>
  </circle>

  <!-- Legend / Extra informative text -->
  <circle cx="225" cy="460" r="6" class="electron" />
  <text x="240" y="465" class="sublabel">= Current (Flow of Charge)</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis in Plants</title>
  
  <!-- CSS Animations -->
  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.8)); }

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - GCSE Chemistry</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .container { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 12; }
    .title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .box-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #334155; text-anchor: middle; }
    .desc { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #64748b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; }
    .arrow { stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 3; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 6 6; marker-end: url(#arrowhead); }
    
    /* Particle styles */
    .particle { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #ef4444; stroke: #b91c1c; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #10b981; stroke: #047857; stroke-width: 2; }

    /* Solid Vibration Animation */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      20% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }
      40% { transform: translate(-2px, 1px); }
      60% { transform: translate(1px, 2px); }
      80% { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }

    .v1 { animation: vibrate 0.3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .v2 { animation: vibrate 0.25s infinite ease-in-out 0.1s; }
    .v3 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out 0.05s; }

    /* Liquid Flow Animation */
    @keyframes flowA {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(12px, -8px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-8px, 10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flowB {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-15px, 6px); }
      66% { transform: translate(10px, -10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flowC {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(8px, 12px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-10px, -6px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    .f1 { animation: flowA 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .f2 { animation: flowB 2.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .f3 { animation: flowC 2.8s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas Fast Random Motion Animation */
    @keyframes gasMove1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-45px, 35px); }
      50% { transform: translate(30px, 50px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-30px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gasMove2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(50px, -30px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-40px, -35px); }
      75% { transform: translate(35px, 40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gasMove3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-30px, -45px); }
      50% { transform: translate(45px, 20px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-50px, 30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    .g1 { animation: gasMove1 1.8s infinite linear; }
    .g2 { animation: gasMove2 1.5s infinite linear; }
    .g3 { animation: gasMove3 1.6s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#94a3b8"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg" />

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" class="title">States of Matter & Particle Arrangement</text>

  <!-- ================= SOLID ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 70)">
    <rect width="220" height="320" class="container" />
    <text x="110" y="35" class="box-title">SOLID</text>
    <text x="110" y="55" class="desc">Fixed shape & volume</text>

    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular Lattice) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 90)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="14" class="particle v1" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="0" r="14" class="particle v2" />
      <circle cx="64" cy="0" r="14" class="particle v3" />
      
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="32" r="14" class="particle v3" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="14" class="particle v1" />
      <circle cx="64" cy="32" r="14" class="particle v2" />

      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="64" r="14" class="particle v2" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="64" r="14" class="particle v3" />
      <circle cx="64" cy="64" r="14" class="particle v1" />

      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="96" r="14" class="particle v1" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="96" r="14" class="particle v2" />
      <circle cx="64" cy="96" r="14" class="particle v3" />
    </g>

    <text x="110" y="275" class="desc" style="font-style: italic;">Close together</text>
    <text x="110" y="295" class="desc" style="font-style: italic;">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Transition Arrow 1 -->
  <path d="M 262 230 L 288 230" class="arrow" />
  <text x="275" y="215" font-family="system-ui" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Heat</text>

  <!-- ================= LIQUID ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 70)">
    <rect width="220" height="320" class="container" />
    <text x="110" y="35" class="box-title">LIQUID</text>
    <text x="110" y="55" class="desc">Takes shape of container</text>

    <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, irregular, flowing) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 90)">
      <!-- We group clusters to animate flowing past each other -->
      <g class="f1"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f2"><circle cx="45" cy="15" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f3"><circle cx="75" cy="25" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>

      <g class="f3"><circle cx="20" cy="45" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f1"><circle cx="55" cy="50" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f2"><circle cx="80" cy="65" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>

      <g class="f2"><circle cx="15" cy="80" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f3"><circle cx="45" cy="85" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f1"><circle cx="75" cy="95" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>

      <g class="f1"><circle cx="25" cy="115" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
      <g class="f2"><circle cx="60" cy="120" r="14" class="particle-liquid" /></g>
    </g>

    <text x="110" y="275" class="desc" style="font-style: italic;">Close, but random layout</text>
    <text x="110" y="295" class="desc" style="font-style: italic;">Move past each other</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Transition Arrow 2 -->
  <path d="M 532 230 L 558 230" class="arrow" />
  <text x="545" y="215" font-family="system-ui" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Heat</text>

  <!-- ================= GAS ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(570, 70)">
    <rect width="220" height="320" class="container" />
    <text x="110" y="35" class="box-title">GAS</text>
    <text x="110" y="55" class="desc">Fills entire container</text>

    <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, fast, random) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 90)">
      <g class="g1"><circle cx="20" cy="30" r="14" class="particle-gas" /></g>
      <g class="g2"><circle cx="80" cy="40" r="14" class="particle-gas" /></g>
      <g class="g3"><circle cx="40" cy="90" r="14" class="particle-gas" /></g>
      <g class="g2"><circle cx="85" cy="110" r="14" class="particle-gas" /></g>
      <g class="g1"><circle cx="25" cy="125" r="14" class="particle-gas" /></g>
    </g>

    <text x="110" y="275" class="desc" style="font-style: italic;">Far apart</text>
    <text x="110" y="295" class="desc" style="font-style: italic;">Move fast in all directions</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= LABELS / KEY TAKEAWAYS ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 430)">
    <!-- Legend items -->
    <circle cx="20" cy="15" r="8" class="particle" />
    <text x="35" y="20" class="label" font-size="14">Particle (Atom / Ion / Molecule)</text>

    <circle cx="320" cy="15" r="8" style="fill: #ffffff; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 2;" />
    <!-- Mini motion lines -->
    <path d="M 312 8 L 308 4 M 328 8 L 332 4" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <text x="335" y="20" class="label" font-size="14">Arrows show movement / vibration</text>
  </g>

</svg>
